# River City Dance Studio

> Ballroom and Latin partner-dance studio in San Antonio, Texas. Bilingual (English/Spanish) instruction, senior-friendly community, beginner public classes every Friday at 7:00 PM. Family-owned and in business for 45+ years.

River City Dance Studio is a family-owned dance school in central San Antonio, Texas. Current owners Chi & Cristine Diaz are longtime instructors who took over the studio to continue its 45-year legacy in the community. The studio specializes in social partner dancing rooted in South Texas culture: Tejano, Cumbia, Country Western Two-Step, Latin (Salsa & Bachata), Swing, and special-occasion choreography (weddings, quinceañeras, anniversaries).

## Location & contact

- Address: 3534 Fredericksburg Rd #24, San Antonio, TX 78201
- Phone: (210) 810-2224
- Email: rivercitydancestudio.sat@gmail.com
- Languages: English and Spanish (bilingual instruction)
- Payments: All card transactions processed securely via Square (major credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, contactless). Cash accepted at the door.

## Class schedule

- Friday, 7:00 PM — Beginner public class (no partner required, all levels)
- Private lessons by appointment (single or couple)

## Pricing

- $145 Starter Bundle — 10-pack of beginner classes (10 hrs), shareable with up to 2 people, no partner needed, 24-hour cancellation credit, bring a friend free to any class. Best value.
- Public drop-in class — $25
- Private lesson, single person — $100
- Private lesson, couple — $150
- Studio rental — submit the rental form for availability and rates

## Services

- Beginner-friendly group classes
- Private lessons for individuals and couples
- Senior-focused, low-impact instruction in a social setting

- Studio rental for private events, rehearsals, and photography

## Guides (articles published on the home page)

- Never Danced Before? A Beginner's Guide to Dance Classes in San Antonio — what a first beginner class is like at River City Dance Studio: arrival, parking, sprung hardwood floor, partner rotation (no partner needed), what to wear, patient pacing, and how to book. Available in English and Spanish.
- Dance for Seniors in San Antonio: Health, Friendship, and Fun After 50 — why partner dancing suits adults over 50: low-impact aerobic activity, balance and fall prevention, memory benefits, and social connection; how the studio accommodates senior dancers. Available in English and Spanish.
- Tejano, Cumbia & Country Western: San Antonio's Dance Styles Explained — the origins and character of Tejano, Cumbia, and Country Western (Texas two-step, polka, waltz) plus Latin ballroom and Swing, and where to learn each locally. Available in English and Spanish.
